articles.title_en: Cardiovascular toxicity as a globally harmonized system hazard trait: The evidence and the path forward
articles.title_cn: 心血管毒性作为全球协调系统危害特征：证据与前进之路
articles.abstract_en: © 2026 Elsevier Inc. All rights are reserved, including those for text and data mining, AI training, and similar technologies. Cardiovascular disease is the leading cause of death globally, yet cardiovascular risks from environmental pollutants remain under-recognized and are not considered a stand-alone hazard trait. Growing evidence shows that industrial and environmental chemicals, including air pollutants, metals, solvents, pesticides and other chemicals, may be hazardous to human cardiovascular health. Indeed, many human and animal studies demonstrate that environmental chemicals can act through oxidative stress, inflammation, and endothelial dysfunction, potentially causing hypertension, arrhythmias, and other cardiovascular conditions. This commentary reviews the state of the science for recognizing chemical cardiotoxicity under the Organisation for Economic Co-operation and Development (OECD) Working Party on Hazard Assessment project [ENV/CBC/HA(2024)13]. New approach methodologies (NAMs) provide organizing principles for assembling mechanism-based data on cardiovascular toxicants and evaluating potential cardiovascular hazards. Case studies demonstrate how broad toxicity testing programs like ToxCast and cardiovascular-specific NAMs can assess hazards and risks for environmental chemical cardiovascular toxicity. The pharmaceutical industry's approach and strategies for de-risking cardiovascular toxicities serve as an example of regulatory applicability of a tiered context-of-use-focused approach consisting of in silico, in vitro and targeted animal and human studies. Overall, a framework for integrating clinical, animal, and NAMs data to support decisions regarding potential chemical cardiovascular toxicity is proposed.

articles.title_en: Advances in the development of heat-resistant aluminum alloys: Composition design, high-temperature performance and stabilization mechanisms
articles.title_cn: 耐热铝合金开发进展：成分设计、高温性能与稳定化机制
articles.abstract_en: The rapid evolution of aerospace, transportation and energy technologies toward higher operating speeds, greater power density and harsher thermal environments has created an urgent demand for aluminum (Al) alloys capable of maintaining excellent performance at intermediate and elevated temperatures. Consequently, heat-resistant Al alloys have emerged as a strategically important class of lightweight structural materials. This review critically examines the current state of heat-resistant Al alloys from both processing and microstructural design perspectives. Based on processing routes, these alloys can be broadly categorized into two major systems: (i) conventionally processed alloys produced via casting or wrought deformation, and (ii) rapidly solidified and additively manufactured alloys enabled by advanced processing technologies. Despite the differences in manufacturing pathways, the high-temperature performance of both systems is ultimately governed by the thermal stability of strengthening phases. These include nanoscale precipitates, ceramic dispersoids and eutectic networks, which act to impede dislocation motion, restrain grain boundary migration and suppress creep. This review summarizes key advances in alloy composition design, phase selection, thermal stabilization mechanisms and microstructural design strategies in heat-resistant Al alloys, while briefly elaborating on the important supporting role of data-driven technologies in the development of high-performance heat-resistant aluminum alloys. Finally, it identifies emerging trends and provides guidance for the development of next-generation Al alloys capable of reliable performance under extreme thermal conditions.
articles.abstract_cn: 航空航天、交通运输和能源技术向更高运行速度、更大功率密度和更严酷热环境的快速发展，产生了对能够在中等和高温下保持优异性能的铝（Al）合金的迫切需求。因此，耐热铝合金已成为一类具有战略重要性的轻质结构材料。本文从加工和微观结构设计两个角度，批判性地审视了耐热铝合金的当前状态。根据加工路线，这些合金可大致分为两大体系：（i）通过铸造或锻造变形生产的常规加工合金，以及（ii）通过先进加工技术实现的快速凝固和增材制造合金。尽管制造途径不同，但两个体系的高温性能最终由强化相的热稳定性决定。这些强化相包括纳米级析出物、陶瓷弥散体和共晶网络，它们起到阻碍位错运动、限制晶界迁移和抑制蠕变的作用。本文总结了耐热铝合金在合金成分设计、相选择、热稳定化机制和微观结构设计策略方面的关键进展，同时简要阐述了数据驱动技术在开发高性能耐热铝合金中的重要支撑作用。最后，本文指出了新兴趋势，并为开发能够在极端热条件下可靠运行的下一代铝合金提供了指导。

articles.title_en: The Joint Spectrum over Trees under the Kingman coalescent with varying population
articles.title_cn: 变种群大小下Kingman聚结过程中树上的联合谱
articles.abstract_en: The Kingman coalescent process models the genealogy of a sample taken from a large population of individuals who reproduce and die according to models such as the Moran or Wright-Fisher processes. The occurrence and spread of neutral mutations in the sample can be modelled by a Poisson process over sample phylogenies from the Kingman coalescent. We study the joint probability distribution of frequencies for multiple mutations occurring on the same tree. We call this the Joint Spectrum over Trees (JST). We derive a closed-form solution for this joint distribution in the case of two mutations with varying population size. We specialise the result for specific population histories, including constant population size. In the process, we highlight how different averaging procedures can lead to different distributions for the frequency of mutations, even when considering only the frequency of a single mutation. We provide a systematic approximation scheme for the Joint Spectrum over Trees under constant population when the number of samples is large. The exact form of the Joint Spectrum over Trees has implications for genealogical inference with the Kingman coalescent, specifically for the characterisation of tree structure near the root and in parameter inference when the underlying tree structures are unknown. To this end, we also comment on the validity of the independence approximation to the true joint distribution under different population histories.
articles.abstract_cn: Kingman聚结过程模拟了从按照Moran或Wright-Fisher等过程繁殖和死亡的大型种群中抽取样本的谱系。样本中中性突变的发生和传播可以通过Kingman聚结过程中样本系统发育上的泊松过程来建模。我们研究了同一棵树上发生的多个突变的频率的联合概率分布，称之为树上的联合谱（JST）。在种群大小变化的情况下，我们推导了两个突变情况下该联合分布的闭式解。我们针对特定的种群历史（包括恒定种群大小）专门化了结果。在此过程中，我们强调了不同的平均过程如何导致突变频率的不同分布，即使只考虑单个突变的频率。在恒定种群下，当样本数量较大时，我们提供了树上联合谱的系统近似方案。树上联合谱的精确形式对Kingman聚结过程中的谱系推断具有重要意义，特别是对于根附近树结构的刻画以及在底层树结构未知时的参数推断。为此，我们还评论了在不同种群历史下独立性近似对真实联合分布的有效性。

articles.title_en: Serological and spatial assessment of lymphatic filariasis transmission interruption in the Coastal Region of Kenya: evidence from Pre-TAS and TAS surveys
articles.title_cn: 肯尼亚沿海地区淋巴丝虫病传播阻断的血清学与空间评估：来自Pre-TAS和TAS调查的证据
articles.abstract_en: BackgroundLymphatic filariasis (LF) remains a health challenge specifically in resources limited settings. ObjectiveThis study evaluated previous LF exposure and the impact of MDA interventions in coastal Kenya using serological and spatial evidence. MethodsA cross-sectional survey was conducted in four LF-endemic counties. Pre-Transmission Assessment Surveys (Pre-TAS) targeted individuals aged ≥15 years, while Transmission Assessment Surveys (TAS) targeted children aged 6-7 years. Wuchereria bancrofti antigen was detected using Filariasis Test Strip (FTS), while IgG4 antibodies against the Bm14 antigen were measured using ELISA. PCR was performed on FTS positive samples. ResultsOverall, ELISA positivity was 12.0% (95% CI: 10.8-13.3%), higher in males (14.4%, 95% CI: 12.4-16.6%), and increased with age, peaking at 20.0%, (95% CI: 15.2-25.7%) among those over 60 years old. Geographic variation was moderate, with Kilifi (12.2%, 95% CI: 10.7-13.9%) and Kwale (11.7%, 95% CI: 9.8-14.0%) showing similar antibody prevalence. At the subcounty level, Kaloleni (18.1%, 95% CI: 13.8-23.5%) and Magarini (15.2%, 95% CI: 10.9-20.8%) had the highest seropositivity, while Msambweni (8.0%, 95% CI: 5.0-12.4%), and Kilifi North had the lowest (8.4%, 95% CI: 5.5-12.8%). ConclusionThese findings indicate persistence of anti-filarial antibodies, particularly in older populations, underscoring the need for robust post-MDA surveillance systems.
articles.abstract_cn: 背景淋巴丝虫病（LF）在资源有限的环境中仍然是一个健康挑战。目的本研究利用血清学和空间证据，评估了肯尼亚沿海地区既往LF暴露及MDA干预措施的影响。方法在四个LF流行县开展了一项横断面调查。传播前评估调查（Pre-TAS）针对年龄≥15岁的个体，而传播评估调查（TAS）针对年龄6-7岁的儿童。使用丝虫病检测试纸条（FTS）检测班氏吴策线虫抗原，并使用ELISA测量针对Bm14抗原的IgG4抗体。对FTS阳性样本进行PCR检测。结果总体ELISA阳性率为12.0%（95%置信区间：10.8-13.3%），男性较高（14.4%，95%置信区间：12.4-16.6%），且随年龄增长而增加，在60岁以上人群中达到峰值20.0%（95%置信区间：15.2-25.7%）。地理变异适中，基利菲（12.2%，95%置信区间：10.7-13.9%）和夸莱（11.7%，95%置信区间：9.8-14.0%）的抗体流行率相似。在县级以下，卡洛莱尼（18.1%，95%置信区间：13.8-23.5%）和马加里尼（15.2%，95%置信区间：10.9-20.8%）的血清阳性率最高，而姆桑布韦尼（8.0%，95%置信区间：5.0-12.4%）和基利菲北（8.4%，95%置信区间：5.5-12.8%）最低。结论这些发现表明抗丝虫抗体持续存在，尤其是在老年人群中，强调需要建立稳健的MDA后监测系统。

articles.title_en: The Confined <mml:math altimg=si453.svg display=inline id=d1e8771><mml:mi>β</mml:mi></mml:math>-Soft rotor model in rare-earth nuclei
articles.title_cn: 稀土核中的受限β-软转子模型
articles.abstract_en: Contemporary theoretical descriptions of nuclear structure rely mainly on microscopic, single-particle frameworks often in competition with collective degrees of freedom, especially when deformation plays a dominant role. Such phenomena are prominent in the rare-earth region, where rotational band structures and enhanced electric quadrupole transitions are systematically examined. The Confined β-Soft (CBS) rotor model, introduced by N. Pietralla and O.M. Gorbachenko, bridges the gap between the X(5) critical point and the rigid-rotor limit in the region where the R4/2=E(4+)/E(2+) ratio lies between 2.904 and 3.333. In the present work, the CBS framework is employed to calculate ground-state band energies, associated B(E2) transition rates, and β-band excitations of even–even nuclei in the rare-earth region. The theoretical results are systematically compared with available experimental data, and predictions are provided for nuclear observables that have not yet been measured, offering guidance for future experimental investigations.
articles.abstract_cn: 当代核结构的理论描述主要依赖于微观的单粒子框架，这些框架常常与集体自由度相竞争，尤其是在形变起主导作用时。这种现象在稀土区域尤为突出，那里系统地研究了转动带结构和增强的电四极跃迁。由N. Pietralla和O.M. Gorbachenko引入的受限β-软（CBS）转子模型，在X(5)临界点与刚性转子极限之间架起了桥梁，该区域中R4/2=E(4+)/E(2+)比值介于2.904和3.333之间。在本工作中，采用CBS框架计算了稀土区域偶偶核的基态带能量、相关的B(E2)跃迁率以及β带激发。理论结果与现有实验数据进行了系统比较，并为尚未测量的核观测量提供了预测，为未来的实验研究提供了指导。

articles.title_en: Atomic Dirac–Hartree–Fock calculations using different nuclear charge distributions with highly accurate Gaussian basis functions
articles.title_cn: 使用不同核电荷分布与高精度高斯基函数的原子狄拉克-哈特里-福克计算
articles.abstract_en: We updated the atomic energy tables of Visscher and Dyall to reflect contemporary developments in nuclear physics and chemistry. To achieve this objective more conveniently, a newly developed, highly accurate Gaussian basis set (single-family exponent even-tempered 80 (SFXE80)) was adopted instead of numerical basis functions in the Dirac–Hartree–Fock calculations. After confirming sufficient accuracy through a comparative assessment with numerical basis functions, the SFXE80 basis set was used to construct the updated total energy tables. Nuclear charge distributions were modeled using the homogeneous charged sphere, Gaussian, two-parameter Fermi (2pF), and augmented Gaussian 12 (AG12) models. A novel semi-analytical formulation was developed to evaluate the nuclear attraction integrals with Gaussian basis functions using the 2pF nuclear charge distribution. Furthermore, the AG12 parameters were fitted to align with the 2pF model definitions used in this study.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们更新了Visscher和Dyall的原子能量表，以反映核物理和化学领域的当代发展。为更方便地实现这一目标，在狄拉克-哈特里-福克计算中采用了新开发的高精度高斯基组（单族指数均匀80（SFXE80）），而非数值基函数。通过与数值基函数的比较评估确认了足够精度后，使用SFXE80基组构建了更新的总能量表。核电荷分布采用均匀带电球体、高斯、双参数费米（2pF）和增强高斯12（AG12）模型进行建模。开发了一种新的半解析公式，用于使用2pF核电荷分布评估高斯基函数的核吸引积分。此外，AG12参数经过拟合，以与本研究中使用的2pF模型定义保持一致。

articles.title_en: The NTP chronic inhalation study does not support an inherent lung cancer hazard of talc: Implications of lung particle overload and maximum tolerated dose
articles.title_cn: NTP慢性吸入研究不支持滑石粉固有的肺癌危害：肺颗粒过载与最大耐受剂量的意义
articles.abstract_en: Interpretation of inhalation carcinogenicity studies for poorly soluble particles requires explicit consideration of lung particle overload in relation to maximum tolerated dose (MTD). In the NTP talc inhalation study, lung tumors occurred in female rats following chronic exposure to 18 mg/m3. Detailed analysis of lung burden data shows that both 6 and 18 mg/m3 exposures resulted in lung overload, with lung volume burdens at 18 mg/m3 exceeding 10 μL/g lung, a level associated with clearance cessation. Together with significant lung pathology and impaired lung function, these findings provide clear evidence that the MTD was exceeded. Analyses of relationships between particle burden, lung cancer, and neutrophilic inflammation across poorly soluble, low-toxicity particles indicate that rat lung tumors following talc exposure arise as a non–material-specific consequence of overload.In recent evaluations, ECHA misinterpreted and discounted the NTP lung burden data, and IARC did not consider lung overload or relevant exposure conditions. As a result, both interpreted these findings as evidence of inherent carcinogenicity.Mechanistically, the rat lung cancer response to talc reflects an inflammation-driven pathway in which excessive lung burdens lead to sustained inflammation and epithelial proliferation. Tumors occur only under conditions exceeding the MTD and represent a non–material-specific, overload-driven effect rather than an inherent carcinogenic hazard. Accordingly, the use of these findings for hazard classification is not scientifically justified.
articles.abstract_cn: 对于难溶性颗粒物的吸入致癌性研究的解读，需要明确考虑肺颗粒过载与最大耐受剂量（MTD）的关系。在NTP滑石粉吸入研究中，雌性大鼠在慢性暴露于18 mg/m3后出现肺肿瘤。对肺负荷数据的详细分析显示，6和18 mg/m3的暴露均导致肺过载，其中18 mg/m3时的肺体积负荷超过10 μL/g肺，这一水平与清除停止相关。结合显著的肺部病理和肺功能受损，这些发现提供了明确证据表明MTD已被超过。对难溶性低毒性颗粒物中颗粒负荷、肺癌和中性粒细胞炎症之间关系的分析表明，滑石粉暴露后大鼠肺肿瘤是非材料特异性过载后果。在最近的评估中，ECHA误解并低估了NTP肺负荷数据，而IARC未考虑肺过载或相关暴露条件。因此，两者都将这些发现解释为固有致癌性的证据。机制上，大鼠对滑石粉的肺癌反应反映了炎症驱动的途径，其中过度的肺负荷导致持续炎症和上皮增殖。肿瘤仅在超过MTD的条件下发生，代表非材料特异性的过载驱动效应，而非固有的致癌危害。因此，将这些发现用于危害分类在科学上是不合理的。

articles.title_en: Consideration of carcinogenicity and mode of action information by an independent expert panel to support derivation of no-significant-risk-level values for vinyl acetate monomer
articles.title_cn: 独立专家小组对致癌性和作用模式信息的审议，以支持推导乙酸乙烯酯单体的无显著风险水平值
articles.abstract_en: A triple-blinded, independent panel of five experts was engaged to review information on the cancer mode of action (MOA) of vinyl acetate monomer (VAM) to provide input on key decisions for the calculation of No-Significant-Risk-Level (NSRL) values using best available science. Based upon the weight of evidence, the panel expressed a strong preference for using effects observed at the point of contact for the NSRL rather than in using those observed in systemic tissues. None of the systemic endpoints were identified as useful for quantitative risk assessment. A cancer MOA involving cytotoxicity and regenerative cell proliferation was best supported by the weight of evidence (mean score of +3.8 ± 1.1; scale of −5 to +5). In contrast, a cancer MOA involving direct genotoxicity was not supported for VAM (mean score of −3.6 ± 2.1). Separate NSRL values were derived for inhalation and oral routes. Based upon the decisions recommended by the panel at each step of the process, inhalation and oral NSRL values of 20,000 and 110,000 μg/day were calculated, respectively. Confidence in the inhalation and oral NSRL values was considered high and medium, respectively by the panel. Human exposures at or below these NSRL levels are not expected to pose a significant cancer risk.
articles.abstract_cn: 一个三盲、由五位专家组成的独立小组被聘请来审查乙酸乙烯酯单体（VAM）的癌症作用模式（MOA）信息，为使用最佳可用科学计算无显著风险水平（NSRL）值的关键决策提供意见。基于证据权重，小组强烈倾向于使用接触点观察到的效应来计算NSRL，而非使用全身组织中观察到的效应。没有任何全身性终点被认为对定量风险评估有用。涉及细胞毒性和再生性细胞增殖的癌症MOA最受证据权重支持（平均得分+3.8 ± 1.1；评分范围−5至+5）。相反，涉及直接遗传毒性的癌症MOA对VAM而言未获支持（平均得分−3.6 ± 2.1）。分别针对吸入和口服途径推导了单独的NSRL值。根据小组在每一步骤推荐的决定，计算得出吸入和口服NSRL值分别为20,000和110,000 μg/天。小组认为吸入和口服NSRL值的置信度分别为高和中等。等于或低于这些NSRL水平的人体暴露预计不会构成显著癌症风险。

articles.title_en: Elemental sensitivity study for <mml:math altimg=si6269.svg display=inline id=d1e60157><mml:mi>s</mml:mi></mml:math>- and <mml:math altimg=si6286.svg display=inline id=d1e60162><mml:mi>i</mml:mi></mml:math>-process nucleosynthesis
articles.title_cn: s过程和i过程核合成的元素敏感性研究
articles.abstract_en: In this paper we present a large-scale sensitivity study of reaction rates in the s and i process. We identified all rates with the highest absolute sensitivity on the production of each element. In addition, the effect of the radioactive decays on the abundances during the time between the end of the nucleosynthesis and the actual observation is considered.
articles.abstract_cn: 在本文中，我们对s过程和i过程中的反应速率进行了大规模敏感性研究。我们确定了每个元素产生具有最高绝对敏感性的所有速率。此外，还考虑了从核合成结束到实际观测之间放射性衰变对丰度的影响。

articles.title_en: Comparative analysis of molecular protocols for detecting <ce:italic>pfhrp2</ce:italic> and <ce:italic>pfhrp3</ce:italic> gene deletions in <ce:italic>Plasmodium falciparum</ce:italic> samples from Rondônia, Brazilian Amazon
articles.abstract_en: BackgroundRapid diagnostic tests (RDTs) based on histidine-rich protein 2 (HRP2) detection are widely used for malaria diagnosis in remote settings. However, deletions in the pfhrp2 and pfhrp3 genes in Plasmodium falciparum compromise RDT performance, with studies reporting varying prevalences. This study compared multiple molecular approaches to assess their concordance and implications for deletion surveillance. MethodsSixty-three P. falciparum-positive clinical samples from Rondônia, Brazil, were analyzed using six PCR protocols: two conventional (cPCR), three quantitative (qPCR), and one droplet digital (ddPCR). Sanger sequencing was performed to investigate the genetic variability of pfhrp2. ResultsDiscrepancies were observed across all methods, particularly at low parasite densities. For pfhrp2, non-amplification rates varied among protocols: 11.1-23.8% for cPCR and 0-9.5% for qPCR. ddPCR did not detect complete deletions. For pfhrp3, non-amplification ranged from 11.1% to 71.4% among qPCR protocols, while ddPCR detected deletions in 95.2% of samples. Sequencing revealed multiple insertion-deletion events in pfhrp2, suggesting local genetic variability contributes to assay discordance. ConclusionDetection of pfhrp2/pfhrp3 deletions is highly dependent on the molecular protocol used. Genetic variability and low parasite density contribute to inconsistent results, potentially leading to incorrect estimation of deletion prevalence. Harmonization of molecular surveillance strategies is essential for reliable monitoring of pfhrp2/pfhrp3 deletions.

articles.title_en: Statistical test to compare the linkage model and the admixture model based on central limit results
articles.title_cn: 基于中心极限结果比较联动模型和混合模型的统计检验
articles.abstract_en: In the Admixture Model, the probability that an individual carries a certain allele at a specific marker depends on the allele frequencies in K ancestral populations and the proportion of the individual’s genome originating from these populations. The markers are assumed to be independent. The Linkage Model is a Hidden Markov Model that extends the Admixture Model by incorporating linkage between neighboring loci.We prove consistency and asymptotic normality of maximum likelihood estimators for the ancestry of individuals in the Linkage Model, complementing earlier results by (Pfaff et al., 2004; Pfaffelhuber and Rohde, 2022; Heinzel, 2025) for the Admixture Model. These results are used to prove that a statistical test that allows for model selection between the Admixture Model and the Linkage Model is an asymptotic level-α-test. Finally, we demonstrate the practical relevance of our results by applying the test to real-world data from The 1000 Genomes Project Consortium (2015).
articles.abstract_cn: 在混合模型中，个体在特定标记处携带特定等位基因的概率取决于K个祖先群体中的等位基因频率以及源自这些群体的个体基因组的比例。假设标记是独立的。链接模型是一种隐马尔可夫模型，通过合并相邻基因座之间的链接来扩展混合模型。我们证明了链接模型中个体祖先的最大似然估计量的一致性和渐近正态性，补充了混合模型的早期结果（Pfaff et al., 2004; Pfaffelhuber and Rohde, 2022; Heinzel, 2025）模型。这些结果用于证明允许在混合模型和关联模型之间进行模型选择的统计检验是渐近水平 α 检验。最后，我们通过将测试应用于 1000 基因组项目联盟 (2015) 的真实世界数据来证明我们的结果的实际相关性。

articles.title_en: Precursor coordination governs defect evolution and nonradiative recombination in wide-bandgap perovskites for monolithic tandem solar cells
articles.title_cn: 前驱体配位调控宽带隙钙钛矿中缺陷演化与非辐射复合，用于单片串联太阳能电池
articles.abstract_en: Wide-bandgap (WBG) perovskites used in monolithic tandem solar cells are limited by nonradiative recombination losses and operational instability originating from defect formation during crystallization and their subsequent evolution under illumination. Here, we show that defect formation can be regulated at the precursor stage by coordination chemistry, instead of relying only on post-crystallization passivation. A fluorinated biguanide molecule, 1-(4-trifluoromethyl)phenylbiguanide hydrochloride (CF3-PhBG-HCl), interacts with undercoordinated Pb2 + species through its multidentate biguanide unit, while the electron-withdrawing –CF3 group modifies surface energetics after film formation. These combined effects influence nucleation and growth, resulting in reduced residual strain, suppressed defect-assisted charge trapping. Consequently, nonradiative recombination is reduced, enabling higher open-circuit voltage (VOC) and improved operational stability in 1.68 eV inverted devices, which achieve an efficiency of 22.99% with a VOC of 1.278 V, and unencapsulated cells retain 87% of their initial efficiency after 913 h of maximum power point tracking. When integrated as the top subcell in a 1.05 cm2 monolithic perovskite/Si tandem, the stabilized absorber delivers 33.65% efficiency and maintains over 89% of its initial output after 600 h of continuous illumination. These results suggest that precursor coordination can limit defect evolution and suppress nonradiative recombination in WBG perovskites, providing a pathway to improved performance and stability in tandem photovoltaics.
articles.abstract_cn: 用于单片串联太阳能电池的宽带隙（WBG）钙钛矿受到非辐射复合损失和运行不稳定性的限制，这些源于结晶过程中缺陷的形成及其在光照下的后续演化。在此，我们表明缺陷形成可以在前驱体阶段通过配位化学进行调控，而非仅依赖结晶后的钝化。一种氟化双胍分子，1-(4-三氟甲基)苯基双胍盐酸盐（CF3-PhBG-HCl），通过其多齿双胍单元与欠配位的Pb2+物种相互作用，而吸电子的–CF3基团在薄膜形成后修饰表面能量状态。这些综合效应影响成核和生长，导致残余应变减少，抑制缺陷辅助的电荷俘获。因此，非辐射复合减少，使得1.68 eV倒置器件能够实现更高的开路电压（VOC）和改进的运行稳定性，其效率达到22.99%，VOC为1.278 V，未封装电池在最大功率点跟踪913小时后保持其初始效率的87%。当作为1.05 cm2单片钙钛矿/硅串联电池的顶部子电池集成时，稳定的吸收层实现了33.65%的效率，并在连续光照600小时后保持其初始输出的89%以上。这些结果表明，前驱体配位可以限制WBG钙钛矿中的缺陷演化并抑制非辐射复合，为串联光伏中提高性能和稳定性提供了一条途径。

articles.title_en: Tailoring Mn-ion batteries through a nonaqueous electrolyte
articles.title_cn: 通过非水电解质定制锰离子电池
articles.abstract_en: © 2026 Elsevier B.V. All rights are reserved, including those for text and data mining, AI training, and similar technologies. Multivalent batteries are intensively studied because of their reliance on metals that are both abundant and accessible worldwide. Although Mn compounds are broadly available, research on Mn-ion batteries remains extremely limited, mainly due to the passivation of Mn metal. Here, we introduce a manganese tetrafluoroborate electrolyte that enables the development of nonaqueous Mn-ion batteries (MIBs). We evaluate the compatibility of this electrolyte with a Mn-metal anode and a wide variety of potential positive or negative electrode materials in Mn-ion batteries. Specifically, we assess the performance of vanadium oxides, manganese oxides, and Prussian blue analogs as positive hosts and Bi- and Te-based electrodes as promising negative electrodes for nonaqueous MIBs.

articles.title_en: A hybrid machine learning approach for high throughput screening of thermodynamically stable double perovskites with optimal band gap
articles.title_cn: 一种用于高通量筛选具有最优带隙的热力学稳定双钙钛矿的混合机器学习方法
articles.abstract_en: © 2026 Elsevier B.V. All rights are reserved, including those for text and data mining, AI training, and similar technologies. The precise and expeditious forecasting of synthesizable materials with optimal band gaps is imperative for developing next-generation optoelectronic applications. This study develops IZ-DPscreen, a hybrid machine learning-powered high-throughput virtual screening engine for identifying thermodynamically stable double perovskites with optimal band gaps. IZ-DPscreen employs a Stacking Regressor, a multi-level ensemble architecture that captures complex, non-linear relationships between essential features and target properties, including band gap, formation energy, and hull stability class. To build this hybrid approach, base models (Gradient Boosting, XGBoost, Random Forest, Support Vector, LightGBM, and Artificial Neural Network) are trained at Level 0, and then meta-models are trained at various stacking levels that leverage the diversity and variance of the base models to achieve more efficient and robust performance. IZ-DPscreen achieves impressive coefficients of determination of 94.3% and 99.2% in band gap and formation energy prediction scenarios. It also demonstrates strong predictive capability in distinguishing double perovskites as stable, metastable, or unstable, achieving a macro F1-score of 0.80. The framework’s robustness is substantiated by comparing its predictions with theoretical and empirical data, showcasing symmetric mean absolute percentage errors predominantly below 10%. Furthermore, to demonstrate the high-throughput screening capability of IZ-DPscreen, the band gaps, formation energies, and hull stability class are predicted for 1000 novel double perovskite compositions, revealing numerous thermodynamically stable candidates with optimal band gaps spanning the infrared, visible, and ultraviolet range. This work thus establishes a high-fidelity, high-throughput screening tool that offers a robust roadmap for prioritizing synthesis efforts toward efficient solar cell and optoelectronic devices.
articles.abstract_cn: © 2026 Elsevier B.V. 保留所有权利，包括文本和数据挖掘、AI训练及类似技术的权利。精确且快速地预测具有最优带隙的可合成材料对于开发下一代光电应用至关重要。本研究开发了IZ-DPscreen，一种基于混合机器学习的高通量虚拟筛选引擎，用于识别具有最优带隙的热力学稳定双钙钛矿。IZ-DPscreen采用堆叠回归器，这是一种多层级集成架构，能够捕捉关键特征与目标属性（包括带隙、形成能和壳稳定性类别）之间的复杂非线性关系。为构建这种混合方法，基础模型（梯度提升、XGBoost、随机森林、支持向量、LightGBM和人工神经网络）在级别0进行训练，然后在不同堆叠级别训练元模型，利用基础模型的多样性和方差实现更高效、更稳健的性能。IZ-DPscreen在带隙和形成能预测场景中分别实现了94.3%和99.2%的令人印象深刻的决定系数。它还在区分双钙钛矿为稳定、亚稳态或不稳定方面表现出强大的预测能力，实现了0.80的宏F1分数。该框架的稳健性通过将其预测与理论和经验数据进行比较得到证实，显示出对称平均绝对百分比误差主要低于10%。此外，为展示IZ-DPscreen的高通量筛选能力，对1000种新型双钙钛矿成分的带隙、形成能和壳稳定性类别进行了预测，揭示了众多热力学稳定的候选材料，其最优带隙跨越红外、可见光和紫外范围。因此，这项工作建立了一种高保真、高通量的筛选工具，为优先考虑高效太阳能电池和光电器件的合成工作提供了稳健的路线图。

articles.title_en: A comprehensive review on transition metal carbides and nitrides for electrocatalytic water splitting
articles.title_cn: 过渡金属碳化物和氮化物用于电催化水分解的全面综述
articles.abstract_en: © 2026 Elsevier B.V. All rights are reserved, including those for text and data mining, AI training, and similar technologies. Transition metal carbides and nitrides (TMCs/TMNs) are promising electrocatalysts for water splitting. They offer noble-metal-like electronic structures, high electrical conductivity, strong chemical stability, and tunable catalytic activity. Despite these advantages, their practical use faces challenges. These include surface oxidation, active-site reconstruction, and limited long-term durability. This review summarizes recent progress in TMC/TMN electrocatalysts for water splitting. We emphasize relationships among synthesis strategies, structural characteristics, electronic properties, and catalytic performance. Representative synthesis methods, including mechanochemical synthesis and rapid synthesis, are systematically discussed. We further highlight performance-enhancement strategies that optimize adsorption behavior, facilitate charge transfer, and improve the kinetics and stability of HER/OER in both water and seawater electrolysis. In addition, key performance descriptors such as Tafel slope, mass activity, turnover frequency (TOF), and long-term stability are discussed to build a comprehensive evaluation framework. Finally, we outline the remaining issues related to stability and degradation and provide perspectives on future directions. This review aims to inform the design and scaling of high-performance TMCs/TMNs.
articles.abstract_cn: © 2026 Elsevier B.V. 保留所有权利，包括文本和数据挖掘、AI训练及类似技术的权利。过渡金属碳化物和氮化物（TMCs/TMNs）是水分解领域有前景的电催化剂。它们具有类似贵金属的电子结构、高电导率、强化学稳定性以及可调的催化活性。尽管有这些优势，其实际应用仍面临挑战，包括表面氧化、活性位点重构以及有限的长期耐久性。本综述总结了TMC/TMN电催化剂在水分解方面的最新进展。我们强调合成策略、结构特征、电子性质与催化性能之间的关系。系统讨论了代表性合成方法，包括机械化学合成和快速合成。我们进一步强调了优化吸附行为、促进电荷转移以及改善水和海水电解中HER/OER动力学和稳定性的性能增强策略。此外，讨论了塔菲尔斜率、质量活性、转换频率（TOF）和长期稳定性等关键性能描述符，以构建全面的评估框架。最后，我们概述了与稳定性和降解相关的剩余问题，并提供了未来方向的展望。本综述旨在为高性能TMCs/TMNs的设计和规模化提供信息。

articles.title_en: Cover 1
Mechanistic-statistical model for the expansion of ash dieback
articles.title_cn: 白蜡树顶枯病扩展的机理统计模型
articles.abstract_en: Hymenoscyphus fraxineus is an invasive forest fungal pathogen that induces severe dieback in European ash populations. The spread of the disease has been closely monitored in France by the forest health survey system which has made it possible to record the symptoms observed in the plots visited. We have developed a mechanistic-statistical model using a partial differential equation (PDE) that describes the spread of the disease. It is particularly adapted for pathogen population dynamics driven by propagation of airborn spores and it allows us to take into account climate (summer temperature and spring rainfall), Allee effect induced by limited sexual partner encounters and host density. We fitted this model using available disease reports. We estimated the parameters of our model by a bayesian method, first identifying the appropriate ranges for the parameters, which led to a model reduction, and then using an adaptive multiple importance sampling algorithm for fitting. The model reproduces well the propagation observed in France over the last 20 years. In particular, it predicts the absence of disease impact in the south east of the country and its weak development in the Garonne valley in south-west France. Summer temperature is the factor with the highest overall effect on disease spread and explains its limited impact in southern France. However, the Allee effect and the heterogeneity of spring precipitation did not have a significant impact on the expansion of H. fraxineus across France and could be disregarded for this large-scale modeling. The model can be used to infer the average annual dispersal of H. fraxineus in France.
articles.abstract_cn: Hymenoscyphus fraxineus 是一种入侵性森林真菌病原体，可在欧洲白蜡树种群中引起严重的枯萎病。在法国，森林健康调查系统一直在密切监测该疾病的传播，从而可以记录在所访问的地块中观察到的症状。我们使用偏微分方程（PDE）开发了一个机械统计模型来描述疾病的传播。它特别适合由空气中孢子传播驱动的病原体种群动态，它使我们能够考虑气候（夏季温度和春季降雨）、有限性伴侣遭遇和宿主密度引起的 Allee 效应。我们利用现有的疾病报告拟合了这个模型。我们通过贝叶斯方法估计模型的参数，首先确定参数的适当范围，从而减少模型，然后使用自适应多重重要性采样算法进行拟合。该模型很好地再现了过去20年在法国观察到的传播情况。特别是，它预测该国东南部不会受到疾病影响，而法国西南部加龙河谷的发展则较弱。夏季气温是对疾病传播总体影响最大的因素，这也解释了其在法国南部影响有限的原因。然而，阿利效应和春季降水的不均一性并没有对 H. fraxineus 在法国的扩张产生显着影响，在这种大规模模型中可以忽略不计。该模型可用于推断 H. fraxineus 在法国的年平均扩散情况。

articles.title_en: Cardiovascular outcomes following intrauterine and lactational exposure to cyantraniliprole in male Wistar rats
articles.title_cn: 雄性Wistar大鼠宫内及哺乳期暴露于氰虫酰胺后的心血管结局
articles.abstract_en: Cyantraniliprole, a systemic insecticide that modulates ryanodine receptors, may impact mammalian physiological systems. Due to its ability to cross biological barriers, the offspring of exposed pregnant females could also be affected. This study evaluated the cardiovascular toxicity following the intrauterine and lactational exposure to cyantraniliprole in pubertal and adult male offspring of Wistar rats. Pregnant rats were treated with water (control), 1 mg/kg (CYA1), or 10 mg/kg (CYA10) of the insecticide by gavage from gestational day 5 until weaning. Biometric parameters in dams and offspring were analyzed to assess toxicity. On postnatal days 55 and 90, male offspring were evaluated for blood pressure, heart rate, and euthanized to evaluate the isolated aortic reactivity and oxidative parameters. No differences were observed between groups regarding maternal and offspring body weight gain during exposure and weight. Also, the arterial blood pressure, heart rate, body weight, and adipose tissue weight were similar between groups. Aortic responses and lipid peroxidation were similar between experimental groups. These results suggest that developmental exposure to cyantraniliprole at the doses tested does not induce detectable adverse cardiovascular functional outcomes in male rat offspring under the experimental conditions employed. These findings also, contribute to developmental risk assessment of ryanodine receptor–targeting insecticides.
articles.abstract_cn: 氰虫酰胺是一种调节兰尼碱受体的系统性杀虫剂，可能影响哺乳动物生理系统。由于其能够穿越生物屏障，暴露于该杀虫剂的怀孕雌性后代也可能受到影响。本研究评估了青春期和成年雄性Wistar大鼠后代在宫内及哺乳期暴露于氰虫酰胺后的心血管毒性。怀孕大鼠从妊娠第5天至断奶期间，通过灌胃给予水（对照组）、1 mg/kg（CYA1）或10 mg/kg（CYA10）的杀虫剂。分析母鼠和后代的生物计量参数以评估毒性。在出生后第55天和第90天，对雄性后代进行血压、心率评估，并实施安乐死以评估离体主动脉反应性和氧化参数。各组之间在母体和后代暴露期间的体重增长及体重方面未观察到差异。此外，各组之间的动脉血压、心率、体重和脂肪组织重量相似。主动脉反应和脂质过氧化在各实验组之间相似。这些结果表明，在所采用的实验条件下，发育期暴露于所测试剂量的氰虫酰胺不会在雄性大鼠后代中诱导可检测的不良心血管功能结局。这些发现也有助于针对兰尼碱受体靶向杀虫剂的发育风险评估。

articles.title_en: Pesticide residue and mycotoxin occurrence in apples and their impact on human health in Morocco
articles.abstract_en: This review evaluates the occurrence of pesticide residues and mycotoxins in Moroccan apples, examines associated human health risks, and discusses challenges related to food safety. A comprehensive meta-analysis of 55 peer-reviewed studies was conducted, focusing on investigations applying the QuEChERS extraction method coupled with high-performance liquid chromatography–tandem m ass spectrometry (HPLC-MS/MS) for accurate contaminant quantification. Fixed-effect and random-effects models were used to account for between-study variability. The results revealed widespread prevalence of organophosphate pesticide residues showing a mean concentration of 0.45 mg/kg, while patulin levels averaged 35 μg/kg and were detected in 80% of analyzed samples. Overall, 70% of apple samples contained detectable pesticide residues, and 60% were contaminated with mycotoxins, indicating a substantial food safety concern. Heterogeneity analysis showed considerable variability among studies, with I2 values of 72% for pesticide residues and 68% for mycotoxins, suggesting strong influences of regional agricultural practices and post-harvest storage conditions. These findings highlight the urgent need for strengthened surveillance programs, stricter regulatory enforcement, and improved agricultural and storage practices to protect consumer health and ensure sustainable apple production in Morocco.

articles.title_en: Clinical and genomic characterization of pediatric adenovirus-associated severe acute respiratory infection: a binational study from Brazil and Colombia, 2022–2023
articles.title_cn: 儿童腺病毒相关严重急性呼吸道感染的临床和基因组特征：一项来自巴西和哥伦比亚的双国研究，2022-2023年
articles.abstract_en: BackgroundHuman adenovirus (HAdV) is detected in fewer than 10% of hospitalized children with acute respiratory infections, yet several regions reported unusual increases in 2021-2022. We investigated an HAdV outbreak detected through surveillance in Curitiba, Brazil, and Antioquia, Colombia, comparing clinical and genomic characteristics before and during the outbreak. MethodsWe conducted a multicenter observational study of HAdV-associated severe acute respiratory infection in hospitalized children. Respiratory samples collected between February 2022 and April 2023 underwent metagenomic sequencing and hexon gene analysis. Clinical and phylogenetic analyses evaluated viral dynamics and genetic diversity. ResultsA HAdV outbreak occurred in both regions during late 2022. HAdV-C predominated before the outbreak, whereas HAdV-B3 became the dominant genotype at both sites during the outbreak. During the outbreak, bronchiolitis/asthma exacerbation was most common in Antioquia, whereas pneumonia predominated in Curitiba. Phylogenetic analysis of the hexon gene identified two distinct HAdV-B3 clades that diverged from a shared ancestor but expanded independently in Brazil and Colombia. ConclusionFollowing relaxation of non-pharmacological measures, both regions experienced a substantial rise in HAdV-B3-associated disease. Despite increased case numbers, clinical patterns remained stable within sites but differed between regions. Integrated genomic and clinical surveillance provides important insights into adenovirus lineage expansion and outbreak dynamics.
articles.abstract_cn: 背景人类腺病毒（HAdV）在因急性呼吸道感染住院的儿童中检出率低于10%，但多个地区在2021-2022年报告了异常增加。我们调查了通过巴西库里蒂巴和哥伦比亚安蒂奥基亚监测发现的HAdV暴发，比较了暴发前后临床和基因组特征。方法我们开展了一项多中心观察性研究，研究对象为因HAdV相关严重急性呼吸道感染住院的儿童。在2022年二月至2023年四月期间收集的呼吸道样本进行了宏基因组测序和六邻体基因分析。临床和系统发育分析评估了病毒动态和遗传多样性。结果两个地区在2022年末均发生了HAdV暴发。暴发前以HAdV-C为主，而暴发期间HAdV-B3成为两个地点的优势基因型。暴发期间，安蒂奥基亚最常见的是细支气管炎/哮喘加重，而库里蒂巴以肺炎为主。六邻体基因的系统发育分析确定了两个不同的HAdV-B3分支，它们从一个共同祖先分化，但在巴西和哥伦比亚独立扩张。结论随着非药物措施的放松，两个地区的HAdV-B3相关疾病均大幅增加。尽管病例数增加，但各地点内部临床模式保持稳定，而地区间存在差异。综合基因组和临床监测为腺病毒谱系扩张和暴发动态提供了重要见解。

articles.title_en: Controllable ordered microstructures in flexible pressure sensors
articles.title_cn: 柔性压力传感器中的可控有序微结构
articles.abstract_en: The performance of flexible pressure sensors (FPSs) critically depends on the design and precise modulation of microstructural configurations in sensing layers or electrode interfaces. COM-FPSs, incorporating controllable ordered microstructures (COMs) with deterministic geometries and spatial ordering, exhibit predictable stress distributions, regulated contact evolution, and reproducible mechano-electrical responses. However, a unified understanding of sensing behavior and fabrication trade-offs in COM-FPSs remains lacking. This review systematically summarizes recent progress in COM-FPSs over the past five years. First, the definition, key characteristics, and significance of COMs are clarified. A Structure–Mechanism–Performance (S–M–P) framework is then established to systematically correlate structure–material coupling, transduction pathways, and sensing performance in COM-FPSs. Subsequently, representative fabrication strategies for COM-FPSs are comparatively analyzed in terms of their structural controllability, reproducibility, scalability, manufacturing trade-offs. Finally, emerging applications are discussed, and key challenges together with prospective solutions are proposed. Overall, this review establishes a COM-centered perspective for understanding S–M–P relationships and fabrication-strategy trade-offs in FPSs, while highlighting the potential of COM-FPSs as scalable and reliable platforms for next-generation intelligent sensing systems.
articles.abstract_cn: 柔性压力传感器（FPSs）的性能关键取决于传感层或电极界面中微结构构型的设计与精确调控。包含具有确定性几何形状和空间有序性的可控有序微结构（COMs）的COM-FPSs，展现出可预测的应力分布、受控的接触演化以及可复现的机电响应。然而，对于COM-FPSs中传感行为和制造权衡的统一理解仍然缺乏。本综述系统总结了近五年来COM-FPSs的最新进展。首先，阐明了COMs的定义、关键特征及其重要性。随后，建立了结构-机制-性能（S-M-P）框架，以系统关联COM-FPSs中的结构-材料耦合、转导路径和传感性能。接着，从结构可控性、可重复性、可扩展性和制造权衡方面，对COM-FPSs的代表性制造策略进行了比较分析。最后，讨论了新兴应用，并提出了关键挑战及前瞻性解决方案。总体而言，本综述建立了以COM为中心的观点，用于理解FPSs中的S-M-P关系和制造策略权衡，同时强调了COM-FPSs作为下一代智能传感系统的可扩展且可靠平台的潜力。

articles.title_en: Canine environmental health: An EPA blind spot? Canine physiology, environmental exposure, and the regulatory gap in U.S. policy
articles.title_cn: 犬类环境健康：美国环保署的盲区？犬类生理学、环境暴露与美国政策中的监管空白
articles.abstract_en: © 2026 Published by Elsevier Inc. The domestic dog occupies an elevated position within the American household, increasingly viewed as analogous to human children, with expectations among owners for human-grade canine healthcare. Federal environmental regulations fail to account for the heightened physiological vulnerability of dogs. This paper explores discrepancies between human and canine environmental exposures, focusing on water consumption, respiratory volumes, and soil ingestion rates. It reveals that environmental standards are calibrated exclusively for humans, leaving companion animals exposed to higher contaminant doses. This paper analyzes the statutory limitations of the EPA, questioning whether legislative silence precludes protecting pets. Finally, it examines whether bipartisan affection for dogs could mobilize a new frontier in environmental politics, and whether the costs of stricter, canine environmental standards would outweigh the electorate's devotion to pets.

articles.abstract_en: © 2026 Published by Elsevier Inc. Vaccines, a proven medical innovation, have reduced mortality from infectious diseases for billions worldwide, when used prophylactically. Vaccine technology is also used to treat disease, including cancer and autoimmune disease, offering effective therapies with limited side effects. Vaccines have a good safety record and most adverse events are transient and minor. Severe adverse events occur but are extremely rare. Safety testing of vaccines is essential and require a toxicology assessment. However, therapeutic vaccines lack specific regulatory guideline and definitions vary globally, which results in confusion, suboptimal study designs and inappropriate species selection. The paper looks at how to design a toxicology program for therapeutic vaccines and considers the 3Rs (Replacement, Reduction, Refinement) by applying the principles of prophylactic vaccine testing. The focus is on species selection and considers the target antigen, mode of action and comparative immunology across mammalian species. The paper highlights that for certain therapeutic vaccines, there may be no relevant species that models the human adaptive immune response, which means the safety assessment is about investigating potential risks related to innate immunity and/or off-target toxicity and as such, considers the future of vaccine toxicology testing in relation to ethics and science.
articles.abstract_cn: © 2026 Elsevier Inc. 出版。疫苗作为一种经过验证的医学创新，在预防性使用时，已降低了全球数十亿人因传染病导致的死亡率。疫苗技术也用于治疗疾病，包括癌症和自身免疫性疾病，提供有效且副作用有限的疗法。疫苗具有良好的安全记录，大多数不良事件是短暂且轻微的。严重不良事件虽发生但极为罕见。疫苗的安全性测试至关重要，需要进行毒理学评估。然而，治疗性疫苗缺乏具体的监管指南，全球定义不一，导致困惑、研究设计欠佳和物种选择不当。本文探讨了如何设计治疗性疫苗的毒理学项目，并通过应用预防性疫苗测试的原则考虑3R原则（替代、减少、优化）。重点在于物种选择，并考虑靶抗原、作用机制以及哺乳动物物种间的比较免疫学。本文强调，对于某些治疗性疫苗，可能没有能够模拟人类适应性免疫反应的相关物种，这意味着安全性评估主要涉及调查与先天免疫和/或脱靶毒性相关的潜在风险，因此，本文考虑了疫苗毒理学测试在伦理和科学方面的未来。
